demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want a Make scenario to send an email through DigitalAka when a trigger occurs in another app.

ease.reason: A small mock can map a supplied event to an email draft; no attached source documents the connection.

evidence.reason: The discussion states a desired triggered email scenario, but gives no frequency, schema, access details or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Concrete requested workflow, but no attached implementation reference documents SMTP configuration or supports the proposed mechanics; assessed below threshold.
